<p>You may be familiar with the protocol upon encountering a bear in the great outdoors:</p><p>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;“If it’s brown, lay down. If it’s black, fight back. If it’s white, good night.” </p><p>&nbsp;And then there’s the lesser-known <em>bear survival strategy</em> the aubs’ vet school dean apparently recommends, “If it’s golden and from the west coast, turnover!”&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;How’d that work out for y’all on Saturday, auburn? Turnovers got you beat by a bunch of hippie bears! And if you think the Cal golden bears are scary, this weekend y’all are facing the Lobos (Spanish for wolf) of New Mexico (not to be mistaken with auburn’s latest nemesis New Mexico <u>State</u>). boogs are gonna be howling at the moon/coach again if they lose to <u>both</u> of New Mexico’s flagship programs. Viva Los Lobos!&nbsp;</p><p>There were several blow outs this past weekend in the SEC - including Vandy killing it again with a win of 55-0 no less. Way to go Commodores! But how surprised were we that South Cackalacky pounded the Wildcats. (Bette Davis was distraught and yelled her little head off for her Kentucky kitties - as seen below - but to no avail, and she had big money on her fav team to win…got to ration the catnip until you win it all back this weekend, BD.)</p><p><img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="IMG_0439.jpg" height="320" width="240"></p><p>&nbsp;(Bette Davis giving it all up for her team when S.C. was on third down.)</p><p>&nbsp;And Alabama is going retro…back to the Stallings era where the team’s play causes us to lose our minds to anxiety and despair and then Coach wins it all. I’ll take it!&nbsp;I’m optimistic about the Tide this weekend even though we struggled at times but <em>held on</em> to win by finally refraining from <em>illegally holding</em> USF. </p><p>The badgers are not going to dig the outcome this Saturday (and, yes, your instincts are correct, that statement and others you have read today qualify as contenders for corniest thing ever written about a football game) even though we are on the road with an 11 am kick…NOOOO…not the EARLY kickoff time and on the ROAD?!? What’s that time zone, you say!?! (CDT)</p><p>An 11 am Kick traditionally for Alabama = the Tide waking up about 12 or 12:30ish pm before coming back strong at the end of the second quarter to win the game. BUT Coach DeBoer changed things up a bit and our team now is scheduled for <em>morning</em> practices. So, hopefully, the early kick will not be the shock to the system it has been in the past. Right?! I like this plan! Get you a mimosa and brunch it up with the Tide for a big Alabama victory Saturday morning!&nbsp;</p><p>Enjoy Week 3 and RTR!</p><p>Jackie&nbsp;</p><p><br></p>
